preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, Node) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root of the tree must be an instance of Node or None.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, Node) or return_value is None
postconditions.description: The returned value must be an instance of Node or None.
The structure and data of the cloned tree must be identical to the original tree.

postconditions.expression: all(id(original_node) != id(cloned_node) for original_node, cloned_node in zip(preorder_traversal(root), preorder_traversal(return_value)))
postconditions.description: All nodes in the cloned tree must be distinct instances from the original tree.
